title: At Work
ringkas: Rapat singkat, meminta bantuan, dan melapor
goals: menyetujui, menunda, dan menolak permintaan secara profesional

lesson.text: Di tempat kerja, jawaban yang singkat, sopan, dan jelas lebih dihargai. Latih balasan untuk rapat singkat, permintaan tolong, dan laporan.

lesson.title: Ungkapan berguna
table: [[Could you give me a hand with ...?]]
[[Thank you, everyone. That's all for today.]]

lines.en: Mr. Adi, could you give me a hand with this report?
lines.id: Pak Adi, bisa bantu saya dengan laporan ini?

lines.en: Of course. What do you need?
I need the sales figures for May.
lines.id: Saya butuh angka penjualan bulan Mei.

lines.en: I'll send them to you this afternoon.

lesson.title: Cara berlatih
lesson.text: Latih tiga kalimat andalan: *I'll get back to you by ...*, *Could you give me a hand with ...?*, dan *I'm afraid I can't ... because ...*.

items: Meminta bantuan: [[Could you give me a hand with ...?]]
Menawarkan bantuan: [[Would you like me to ...?]]
Melaporkan progres: [[I've finished ... / I'm working on ...]]
Menunda: [[I'll get back to you by ...]]

practice.q: Could you give me a hand with this file?
turns: Could you give me a hand with this file?
answers: Sure, what do you need?
Of course. Let me take a look.
Yes, no problem.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: Sure, what do you need?  atau  Of course. Let me take a look.  atau  Yes, no problem.

practice.q: How is the report going?
answers: It's about eighty percent done.
I've almost finished. I just need the final numbers.
It's going well. I'll finish it today.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: It's about eighty percent done.  atau  I've almost finished. I just need the final numbers.  atau  It's going well. I'll finish it today.

practice.q: When can you send it to me?
turns: When can you send it to me?
answers: I'll send it before five o'clock.
By five this afternoon.
I can send it by five.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: I'll send it before five o'clock.  atau  By five this afternoon.  atau  I can send it by five.

practice.q: Do you have the customer list?
practice.scene: Rekan meminta data yang belum kamu punya.
turns: Do you have the customer list?
answers: Not yet. I'll get back to you soon.
I don't have it now, but I'll find it.
Let me check and get back to you.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: Not yet. I'll get back to you soon.  atau  I don't have it now, but I'll find it.  atau  Let me check and get back to you.

practice.q: What seems to be the problem?
turns: What seems to be the problem?
answers: My computer won't start.
The computer doesn't turn on.
There's a problem with my computer.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: My computer won't start.  atau  The computer doesn't turn on.  atau  There's a problem with my computer.

practice.q: Can you take on this project?
turns: Can you take on this project?
answers: Sure. When is the deadline?
Yes, I'd be happy to. What's the deadline?
OK, I'll do it. When do you need it?
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: Sure. When is the deadline?  atau  Yes, I'd be happy to. What's the deadline?  atau  OK, I'll do it. When do you need it?

practice.q: Would you like me to take notes?
turns: Would you like me to take notes?
answers: Yes, please. Thank you!
That would be great, thanks.
Thanks, that would help.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: Yes, please. Thank you!  atau  That would be great, thanks.  atau  Thanks, that would help.

practice.q: Can you join the meeting at four?
turns: Can you join the meeting at four?
answers: I'm sorry, I have a deadline at four.
Sorry, I can't. I'm busy then.
I'm afraid I can't. Can I join later?
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: I'm sorry, I have a deadline at four.  atau  Sorry, I can't. I'm busy then.  atau  I'm afraid I can't. Can I join later?

practice.q: Let's begin the meeting.
practice.id: Katakan kamu siap dan membawa laporan.
answers: I'm ready, and I have the report.
Ready. I've brought the report.
OK, I have my report with me.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: I'm ready, and I have the report.  atau  Ready. I've brought the report.  atau  OK, I have my report with me.

practice.q: I suggest we start next Monday.
turns: I suggest we start next Monday.
answers: That sounds good to me.
I agree. Monday is fine.
Yes, that works.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: That sounds good to me.  atau  I agree. Monday is fine.  atau  Yes, that works.

practice.q: We should cut the budget by half.
turns: We should cut the budget by half.
answers: I'm not sure that is a good idea.
I'm worried that is too much.
Could we discuss other options?
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: I'm not sure that is a good idea.  atau  I'm worried that is too much.  atau  Could we discuss other options?

practice.q: Is Mr. Adi there?
practice.id: Katakan dia sedang rapat dan tawarkan menyampaikan pesan.
answers: He's in a meeting. Can I take a message?
Sorry, he's in a meeting. Would you like to leave a message?
He's busy right now. Can I help?
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: He's in a meeting. Can I take a message?  atau  Sorry, he's in a meeting. Would you like to leave a message?  atau  He's busy right now. Can I help?

practice.q: I'm leaving now.
answers: OK, see you tomorrow!
Have a good evening! See you.
Take care, see you tomorrow.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: OK, see you tomorrow!  atau  Have a good evening! See you.  atau  Take care, see you tomorrow.

practice.q: Here is the file.
answers: Thank you so much.
Thanks for your help.
Thank you, that's very helpful.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: Thank you so much.  atau  Thanks for your help.  atau  Thank you, that's very helpful.

practice.q: Pilih balasan yang profesional untuk "Could you give me a hand?"
options: Sure, what do you need?
No way, I am too busy to help you with that today.
I do not care about your file, so ask someone else.
Ask somebody else, please; I do not have time at all.
practice.exp: Menyetujui. Jawaban yang tepat: **Sure, what do you need?**

practice.q: Pilih ungkapan untuk menunda dengan sopan:
options: I'll get back to you soon.
Never mind, I will not be able to help you with that.
I forgot about it, so please ask someone else instead.
Do not ask me again about this matter, please.
practice.exp: Menunda. Jawaban yang tepat: **I'll get back to you soon.**

practice.q: Pilih ungkapan untuk menolak dengan sopan:
options: I'm afraid I can't join. I have a deadline.
I do not want to join because that meeting sounds boring.
That is not my job, so please find another person to join.
No time for you today, and I will not join anyway.
practice.exp: Menolak. Jawaban yang tepat: **I'm afraid I can't join. I have a deadline.**

practice.q: Pilih ungkapan melaporkan progres:
options: I've finished the first part and I'm working on the second.
I did something yesterday, and I will do something else later.
Maybe I will finish it, but I am not sure about the time.
It is somewhere on my desk, and I will find it later.
practice.exp: Progres. Jawaban yang tepat: **I've finished the first part and I'm working on the second.**

practice.q: Pilih ungkapan menutup rapat:
options: Thank you, everyone. That's all for today.
Bye, everyone; the meeting was long and quite boring today.
We are finished now, so you may all go home immediately.
Stop talking now, because the time for the meeting is over.
practice.exp: Menutup. Jawaban yang tepat: **Thank you, everyone. That's all for today.**

practice.q: Pilih balasan pesan telepon yang baik:
options: He's in a meeting. Can I take a message?
He does not want to talk to anyone at the moment, sorry.
Please call again later because I do not know where he is.
I do not know him, so I cannot help you with this.
practice.exp: Pesan telepon.
